title: Provenance manifest for the WITHDRAWN pooled division-separability analysis
why_invalid: Codex challenge v1 finding 3 (verified by Claude): pooling the 6 causal-audit files is pseudo-replication. The 6 files are only 3 distinct byte streams, all sharing the SAME 2 positive sites (both 6bba), so 'pooled N=12 positives' is really N=2. The files also run with deepcenter_safe_div_veto=false, unlike the 0.944 production gate (veto @0.25). The reported pooled AUC does not escape N=2 and is withdrawn.

script.note: Discovers inputs via glob at runtime; the exact inputs it consumed on 2026-09-16 are frozen below. Do not treat the live-glob behavior as the provenance record.

shared_positive_sites.note: Every file contributes the same 2 source_maps_gt_division=True candidates. Positive experimental unit = 2, not 12.

production_0944_gate_veto: enabled @ 0.25 (val_049), so these audits are not the production candidate population
captured_output_2026_09_16: per-run pos=2/neg~1128, AUC(deepcenter_score->maps_gt_division)=0.360-0.363; causal AUC 0.417-0.440; POOLED (pseudo) AUC 0.362, causal 0.430; median deepcenter_score maps_gt=True 1.233e-07 < False 2.899e-07. THESE NUMBERS ARE WITHDRAWN AS EVIDENCE per the pseudo-replication finding; retained only to document what was computed.
